# Material

Translucent surfaces for things that float above other UI and stay connected to what is behind them: a Tag on an illustration, a floating button, a floating Panel, a Modal on the Blanket. Material varies the surface a layer uses, never the layer.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/ElevationMaterial.mdx`

## Material ramp

Three materials, from most to least see-through. The bigger the surface and the longer its text, the less it lets through.

## Material tokens

A material surface is three tokens together. The fill alone dissolves on busy content.
